scope: Closed bounded Kubernetes managed/trimmed ARM64 diagnostics, not formal performance or endurance acceptance.

latencies.scope: Acceptance uses client HTTP elapsed time. Delivery starts at the fsynced client intent timestamp and ends at the first successful handler completion record, before receipt fsync. All pods share the same VM UTC clock. Unknown outcomes stay separate even if delivered; extra deliveries are evaluated independently.

replay.scope: Three owned runtime containers SIGKILLed behind one barrier, with all original runtimes absent before releasing any restart. Same pod UIDs and original volumes/WAL geometry/storage identities retained; cold bootstrap permission remains consumed. Gated confirmed async plus Set/Files seeds are validated after replay. Cost samples end before this separate fault phase.

policy_cost.scope: Same-source bounded200x1MiB/C16, WAL64KiB/offload512KiB, policies0/1/2/2/1/0. Diagnostic budget screen, not the formal HTTP matrix. CPU from first intent-to-drain resource window; final180s CPU includes idle polling and remains in original reports. All three runtime processes; sampled RSS; function/generator CPU excluded. Raft counter sums the existing batch-append metric across all runtimes, matching the formal comparer.
